$comment: Scheduled posting (flag post-schedule; D310, D314, D375). Every automatic YouTube upload goes up with status.publishAt (YouTube Studio shows it as Scheduled; it goes public at that time); an automatic upload without a time never happens (it waits). Slot rule (D375, placement fill-gaps): the earliest time, on the alignMinutes grid (60 = whole hours, UTC), that is at least now + minLeadHours + marginMinutes and at least intervalHours away from EVERY taken time: each scheduled post on the channel, each channel video published recently, every time already in the upload queue (uploaded, open session, failed, queued) and every slot given out earlier in the same pass. So new posts fill the gaps around the existing schedule and no two posts are less than intervalHours apart. placement after-last keeps the old D310 rule (start after the latest taken time + intervalHours). A D314 retry (a queued clip whose time came less than minLeadHours away before its upload session started) gets a new slot by the same rule; other queued clips keep theirs. A slot more than maxAheadDays ahead is not given out: the clip waits. Before an upload session starts or resumes, the slot must still be at least minLeadHours ahead; before every chunk, at least marginMinutes ahead. Every chunk request is aborted chunkDeadlineSeconds before the slot, and the final chunk only starts when its estimated transfer time fits (slowest chunk measured in this upload, else fallbackKbps; chunkDeadlineSeconds must be less than marginMinutes x 60). Channel read (Codex review 2026-11-21, D409): the WHOLE uploads list, pageSize per page, to its last page; it is made again right before each new upload session and before Post now (public). If maxPages is reached with pages left, the read is incomplete and nothing is scheduled or uploaded (fail closed); a channel with more than maxPages x pageSize uploads must raise maxPages. lookbackDays no longer ends the scan (an old upload can still carry a future publish time, so the old lookback risk is gone); it is kept only so older settings files still load. The user's own settings (Settings > Posting & growth > Auto-post) are saved in <data dir>/posting/schedule.json and replace intervalHours, maxAheadDays and placement (that file also holds quotaUnitsPerDay, see data/posting/quota.json); they apply on the next pass, no restart. Read by services/posting/schedule.mjs; never hardcoded. YouTube Data API quota: 1 unit per channels.list, playlistItems.list and videos.list call (1 + up to 2 per page).
source: PT2 (D408, user 2026-11-21: 'only not allowed rule should be - if there is scheduled video exists - the new schedule videos should only come 1 hr before or after the already scheduled one'): minGapMinutes 60 is the default and the floor (HARD_GAP_MINUTES in schedule.mjs; a user gap may be wider), windowEnd may be 24:00 (whole day), posts a day up to 24. recheckMaxAgeMinutes: retired by the Codex review 2026-11-21 (D409): the channel is read again right before EVERY new upload session, whatever the age of the last read; the value is still accepted but not used. Earlier: placement random-daily with postsPerDayMin 3, postsPerDayMax 6, windowStart 09:00, windowEnd 23:00 (this PC's local time, DST-safe) and minGapMinutes 90: user 2026-11-19 (D403: 'setup the autoposting schedule ... spread out randomly'; the user chose random 3-6 posts a day between 09:00 and 23:00 at least 90 minutes apart). In random-daily every gap (channel posts, the queue, a moved clip) is minGapMinutes and times are on whole minutes; intervalHours and alignMinutes apply to fill-gaps and after-last only. The random plan is seeded (seed in the user's schedule.json, made once), so it stays the same across passes and restarts. intervalHours 1: user 2026-11-13, later the same day ('build a posting schedule every one hour for the next 2 months'; first that day 6 h 'for the time being', before that 6 h on 2026-11-09). placement fill-gaps: user request 2026-11-13 ('schedule the posts according to work around the existing schedule. don't double post at the same time'). maxAheadDays 60: user 2026-11-13 ('for the next 2 months'); the user's own setting may go up to 730 days (user 2026-11-09, D314, 'can schedule upto 2 years ahead'). alignMinutes 60, lookbackDays 120 (unused since D409), maxPages 40: agent 2026-11-13 (D375), not a user instruction: whole hours match the channel's own schedule; 40 pages = 2000 uploads, at most 81 quota units per read (1 + 2 per page), reserved before each read and counted in the uploads-a-day sum (data/posting/quota.json). minLeadHours, marginMinutes, chunkDeadlineSeconds (coordinator review 2026-11-09: about 2 min), fallbackKbps, pageSize: agent default 2026-11-09, not a user instruction; tune here. minGapMinutes (D314 gap, 2026-11-09) retired 2026-11-13: every gap is intervalHours now.
